about: What the LmCoop developers have tested. status: verified (works), partial (works for part of the mod), broken. Mods not listed are untested. Keyed by GameBanana mod id.

552512.note: Dolphin-style texture pack: installs from the Mods screen and repaints the foyer, Luigi and the HUD (tested with LmCoop 1.6.0, 2,355 textures; only the first rooms were looked at).

578253.note: Loose game files (288): installs from the Mods screen and the game serves them (the mansion map, the game archive, the intro cutscenes); the foyer loaded and showed the changes. Other rooms were not tested.

525393.note: Wega's Freaky Mansion: its playable Luigi and his voice banks work through a character pack (tested with LmCoop 1.5.0, USA disc). Cutscene models and the rest of the mod are not used.
